_comment: THE AUTHOR'S RECORD. Nothing in the plugin reads this file - a slot loads the module name it
was compiled with, and that is the whole binding.
ONE EXCEPTION, AND IT IS SPECIFIC TO EXPORTERS: the two fields under 'exporter' below are
deployed as a sidecar beside your payload, and the slot DOES read that. An exporter's file
extension cannot be compiled into the slot - a slot with one baked in would host your OBJ
cartridge and write .ase. So you declare it, and the slot asks when the host builds the
name: @DISPLAY_NAME@

exporter._comment: ext: the file extension, WITHOUT a dot, as it appears in Save as type. shortDesc: what that list shows.
